source.title: Forebears Zambia forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to replace the legacy seed with broader localized samples. Gender buckets remain sample-level because they are not sourced from an official civil registry.

source.title: ITU Zambia national numbering plan communication of 24.XII.2024

phones.notes: ITU/ZICTA confirms country code +260, nine-digit national significant numbers, and these assigned mobile NDCs. Free, reserved and non-mobile ranges are intentionally omitted.

source.title: UPU General Addressing Issues postcode-length table

locations.notes: UPU confirms a five-digit postcode length for Zambia. Region, city and street samples are public-geography review data; postalPrefixes are generator prefixes and not full address validation.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO Zambia ordinary passport document entry

passport.notes: PRADO confirms the Zambia ordinary passport document family, but the public entry reviewed does not confirm a passport-number grammar. ZMP is a generator marker, not a claimed passport prefix.

national_registration_card_number.label: National Registration Card Number

source.title: Zambia Ministry of Home Affairs national registration service

national_registration_card_number.notes: Official public material confirms National Registration Card issuance, but no official public NRC number grammar, checksum or semantic digit rule was confirmed. NRC is a generator marker, not a claimed card prefix.
